column1: # The project this engine's committed answers come from. BigQuery is a Google
# Cloud service: there is no image and no container, so image names the project
# and the dataset's location, digest is the SHA-256 of what `datasets.get`
# states as `<id> <location> <creationTime>`, and the source tag is the day the
# answers were recorded. A dataset recreated anywhere else answers another
# creationTime, so its digest moves and the pin fails instead of quietly
# replaying. The service account is never part of a pin.
# columns: role, image, digest, source tag
